rubric.why: Galvanizing protects iron or steel by coating it with zinc.
rubric.description: Defines galvanizing as coating iron or steel with zinc.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying zinc as the coating on iron or steel.

rubric.why: The zinc coating protects the underlying metal from rusting or corrosion.
rubric.description: States a protective advantage of galvanizing.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that galvanizing prevents rusting or corrosion.

modelAnswer: Galvanizing is the process of coating iron or steel with a layer of zinc.
It protects the iron or steel from rusting and corrosion.
